title: WP Variance Analysis
description: Schema for WP-level effort variance analysis data stored as GitHub Issue comments. Records 3-point estimation (initial/planed/actual) and 2-axis variance (planning phase vs execution phase).

schema.description: Schema version identifier for forward compatibility.

wpName.description: Work Package name as defined in the backlog (e.g. 'WP_2: Interactive移行スクリプト作成').
examples: WP_2: Interactive移行スクリプト作成

effortInitial.description: Pre-plan estimate: initial intervention count estimated at WP creation or selection time.

effortPlaned.description: Post-plan estimate: revised intervention count after PO alignment during session-planning. Null if not yet planned.

effortActual.description: Actual intervention count recorded at session end via record-session-metrics. Null if not yet completed.

varianceInitialToPlaned.description: Planning-phase variance: effortPlaned - effortInitial. ≥ 0 in practice (planed < initial is virtually impossible). > 0 indicates ambiguous requirements/ACs.

variancePlanedToActual.description: Execution-phase variance: effortActual - effortPlaned. Positive = implementation harder than planned; negative = smoother than expected.

varianceTotal.description: Total variance: effortActual - effortInitial. Overall deviation from initial estimate.

varianceReason.description: Qualitative explanation of the root cause of variance. Follows metrics-guide.md effort_variance_reason convention.
examples: 設計見直しによりスコープ拡大。当初想定より複雑なエッジケース対応が必要だった

status.description: WP completion status at time of recording.

recordedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this variance data was recorded.
